gold.user: As a developer, I want to retrieve the OIDC custom subject template for my organization to ensure that it aligns with our identity management policies.
gold.ideal: The API should return the current OIDC custom subject template for the specified organization, including any relevant details about its configuration.

gold.user: As an admin, I need to update the OIDC custom subject template for my organization to reflect changes in our user identification strategy.
